headline: Light mode, high contrast, custom source + more
notes:
✨ Light mode + High contrast. Segue isn't dark-only anymore. Pick Light, Dark or High contrast in Preferences > Appearance and the whole app restyles instantly.

🎮 Interact button. Bound by default to the button you enter races with. It stops the D-pad from skipping tracks in menus (garage, Auto Show, Return Home), then frees it when you drive off. Rebind it in settings.


🎵 Custom source. Use any playing app as your music source, even one that's not in the list.


🎯 Combo binds. Bind two buttons pressed together as one, like LB + Square.


✌️ Tap / Hold. One button, two jobs: tap to skip, hold for volume.


Smaller changes
🔧 Faster + cleaner. Snappier reopen, no white flash, and Space plays or pauses.
🎨 UI polish. Smoother scrolling, restyled scrollbar, cleaner menus and update notices.
🩹 Screensaver + sleep. Work again with a controller plugged in.
